notes: Saduq's own statement of how he received the book, with no saying: both routes are kept as groups
«جميعا» marks co-transmitters at one level: Ayyub with Ibrahim ibn Hashim (from Safwan), and Safwan with Ibn Abi Umayr (from Muhammad ibn Hamran)
«أبي» and «أبيه» are relations with no name written (rule 7); the names are not filled from the other sources
